annotations.text:
8.5 x 11, double-sided. Both fronts share the same back, so you only ever print one back.

Send to the printer: 100lb gloss text (flexible, cheap) or 14pt cover (feels like a real leave-behind). Ask for 0.125" bleed — the dark header, hero and footer all run to the edge.

The QR points to ceilingsrus.net/10-off — that page has to exist before anything goes to print.

Fine print still needs an end date. Everything else on this side is final.

This is the page the QR opens. Nearly every scan will be the phone version on the right, so that one is the real design — the desktop layout is for anyone who types the URL.

Form fields here are drawn, not working. The live WordPress version is a separate file in the repo.
